messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?" They want the freezing point of water at 10 kPa.
